$comment: The test-execution manifest. Every test project in TaxAI.sln must be listed here.
minimumTests is a FLOOR, not an expected value. It is the count the project was
known to run when it was last updated. Counts only ever grow, so a run below the
floor means tests were lost, filtered out, or silently not executed.
Raise a floor when a spec adds tests. Never lower one to make a run pass: a falling
count is the defect this file exists to catch.
Adding a new test project? Add it here in the same PR. The gate fails on an
unregistered project on purpose - a project nobody registered is a project nobody
